subject: r batch files: command ""\R.exe"" wrong or couldn't be found.

messages.author: d8df2fb358af885e
messages.subject: r batch files: command ""\R.exe"" wrong or couldn't be found.
parts:
Hi,

some times ago I've added the r batch files to winGRASS [1] for a smooth R-GRASS GIS coupling. it worked quite well; thanks for the r batch files!

the r batch files are included in the folder

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin

which is in %PATH%.

recently it seems to be broken as there is following error message within a winGRASS session:

Welcome to GRASS GIS 7.1.svn (r64877)
GRASS GIS homepage: http://grass.osgeo.org
This version running through: Command Shell
(C:\windows\system32\cmd.
exe)
Help is available with the command: g.manual -i
See the licence terms with: g.version -c
[...]
Microsoft Windows [Version 6.1.7601]
Copyright (c) 2009 Microsoft Corporation. Alle Rechte vorbehalten.

C:\Users\xxxx>R
Der Befehl ""\R.exe"" ist entweder falsch geschrieben oder
konnte nicht gefunden werden.
(translation: Command ""\R.exe"" is wrong or couldn't be found)

R is installed in C:\Program Files\R\R-3.1.2

when I open a MS windows command line and switch to the folder mentioned above, it works:

C:\Users\xxxxx>cd C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin>R

R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31) -- "Pumpkin Helmet"
Copyright (C) 2014 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

any idea what's going wrong?

thanks and regards
Helmut


[1] http://grasswiki.osgeo.org/wiki/R_statistics#GRASS_7_Usage
